summary.en-US: Keep one Firefox network identity consistent: proxy, public IP, approximate location, timezone, and WebRTC.

version.approval_notes: Reviewer notes are in docs/AMO-REVIEW.md in the uploaded source archive. The extension is Firefox-only. Proxy passwords stay in storage.session. A fresh install does not create a profile or contact a GeoIP service. Map code is bundled; tile.openstreetmap.org receives image requests only while the options page is open. Do not treat an unsigned GitHub zip as the user installer.
